disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person, firm or corporation who makes an oil, solid fuel, propane or natural gas installation without being licensed as provided by subchapter 3 or who employs an unlicensed person to make installations is subject to the provisions of Title 10, section 8003‑C.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Neglecting or refusing to comply with an order of a state fuel inspector for more than 10 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the owner, occupant of any building or an installer neglects or refuses, without justification, for more than 10 days to comply with any order of a state fuel inspector, that person commits a civil violation for which a fine of not less than $100 for each day's neglect may be adjudged.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: 32 §18111. Failure to comply with order of a state fuel inspector

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide required NFPA disclosure statement to a consumer prior to chimney or fireplace installation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any chimney or fireplace installer who fails to provide the required disclosure statement to a consumer prior to the installation of a chimney or fireplace commits a civil violation for which a fine of not less than $500 may be adjudged.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: An application for licensure of a dispensing station or self-service dispensing station must be made by the owner and, if approved by the board, the license must be issued in the name of the owner.

A propane and natural gas technician may install, repair or service propane or natural gas equipment
Tank setting and outside piping, which permits the technician to set and maintain propane tanks and outside piping.
"Chimney" means a factory-built, masonry or metal chimney constructed to allow one or more vertical or nearly vertical passageways for conveying flue gases from a building to the outside atmosphere.

"Accessory equipment" means equipment, materials and controls that are not integral parts of the oil, solid fuel, propane or natural gas burning unit but that are connected to the oil, solid fuel, propane or natural gas burning unit and have the potential to affect the safety of the equipment.
